title: Four papers accepted
summary: The lab announced one journal article and three CHI PLAY 2025 papers. Congratulations to all the authors.
details: “This is Human Intelligence Debugging Artificial Intelligence”: Examining How People Prompt GPT in Seeking Mental Health Support — Zhuoyang Li, Zihao Zhu, Xinning Gui, and Yuhan Luo · International Journal of Human-Computer Studies
More Than Just Microtransactions: Predatory Monetization in User-Generated Games — Zinan Zhang, Sam Moradzadeh, Xinning Gui, and Yubo Kou · CHI PLAY 2025
Gendered Toxicity in Competitive Gaming: Women’s Perceptions and Responses — Elena Koung, Zinan Zhang, Xinning Gui, and Yubo Kou · CHI PLAY 2025
Fake Game but Real Play: Exploring Player Motivations and Coping Strategies with Fake Games — Sam Moradzadeh, Jeffery Seihoon Oh, Xinning Gui, and Yubo Kou · CHI PLAY 2025
